text: The two lads and the two women
why: ¶34 says the two lads and the two women (Mrs. Straker and the maid) ran out to search.

text: Did the dog bark in the night?
why: A dog was kept in the stable and the lads heard nothing all night, which gives a reader reason to wonder whether it barked.

text: Did the dog bark in the night? — barked, unheard by sound sleepers
why: The text says the lads are sound sleepers who heard nothing, so this possibility is grounded.

text: Did the dog bark in the night? — did not bark
why: That the dog stayed silent is a plain alternative reading of 'heard nothing'.
